basic_info.description: This exceptional 4BR, 2.5 BA Victorian property, built in 1908, is on the market for the first time in 37 years and provides lots of potential! It boasts numerous period details, set on a deep lot, it offers rare and beautiful views of downtown, city, and Bay. The main level features foyer, bedroom, formal dining room, and an open-concept living room with French doors that lead to a view deck with stairs to the garden. This level also includes a chef's kitchen, a pantry, closets, and a bathroom with a stackable washer/dryer. The upstairs level consists of 3 generously sized bedrooms and bathroom. Two of these bedrooms form a double parlor, divided by a wide pocket door, and feature large bay windows. The primary bedroom opens onto a view deck and offers ample closet space, with one closet providing access to a stairway leading to two bonus attic rooms with views. The lower level provides a spacious full-height, updated basement with huge storage/workshop area, half bath, and French doors that open to a patio and garden. Located close to a Slow Street, this home is nestled between the Noe Valley, Bernal & Glen Park  triangle with convenient access to Muni, BART, schools, Day St. SF Recreation & Park, shops, restos, the Village and has easy access to tech shuttles & fwy
